mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of periods with 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, S&P 500 delivers negative 20-day returns, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.5% for 3 months, S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicate contracting household demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 months, S&P 500 delivers positive 60-day returns in >50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In INDPRO < 100 periods, S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 320.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 320.0, S&P 500 delivers positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Payrolls growth exceeding 150,000 jobs per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 150000, S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction above 1350 thousand units indicates housing market strength that stimulates consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In HOUST > 1350 periods, S&P 500 delivers negative 60-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 indicates manufacturing expansion that supports economic growth and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In INDPRO > 105 periods, S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.
